title: Formula Sheet & Chemical Reactions Cheat Sheet
objectives: Quickly review all 5 reaction types, key precipitate colours, and reactivity series mnemonics

blocks.heading: The 5 Reaction Archetypes & Signatures
blocks.content:
| Type | General Form | Archetype Equation | Key Signature |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Combination | $A + B \to AB$ | $\text{CaO} + \text{H}_2\text{O} \to \text{Ca(OH)}_2$ | Exothermic, hissing sound |
| Decomposition | $AB \to A + B$ | $2\text{FeSO}_4 \xrightarrow{\Delta} \text{Fe}_2\text{O}_3 + \text{SO}_2 + \text{SO}_3$ | Green crystals turn brown, pungent smell |
| Displacement | $A + BC \to AC + B$ | $\text{Fe} + \text{CuSO}_4 \to \text{FeSO}_4 + \text{Cu}$ | Blue solution turns light green |
| Double Disp. | $AB + CD \to AD + CB$ | $\text{Na}_2\text{SO}_4 + \text{BaCl}_2 \to \text{BaSO}_4 \downarrow + 2\text{NaCl}$ | White precipitate forms instantly |
| Redox | $\text{Red} + \text{Ox}$ | $\text{CuO} + \text{H}_2 \to \text{Cu} + \text{H}_2\text{O}$ | Black CuO turns reddish brown |

blocks.heading: Essential Precipitate Colors
blocks.content:
• **BaSO4 (Barium Sulphate):** White precipitate
• **PbI2 (Lead Iodide):** Bright Yellow precipitate ($Pb(NO3)2 + 2KI \to PbI2\downarrow + 2KNO3$)
• **AgCl (Silver Chloride):** White precipitate (turns grey in sunlight)
• **Cu(OH)2 (Copper Hydroxide):** Pale Blue precipitate
• **Fe(OH)3 (Iron Hydroxide):** Reddish-brown precipitate

steps: Step 1: A single substance (AgCl) breaks down into two elements (Ag and Cl2).
Step 2: Energy is supplied by sunlight (photons).
Step 3: This is a Photochemical Decomposition Reaction.

practice.prompt: What colour precipitate is formed when potassium iodide is added to lead nitrate solution?
hints: Lead iodide (PbI2) precipitate has a characteristic bright yellow colour.

takeaways: Keep this cheat sheet handy for CBSE board practical and multiple-choice color questions.
Corrosion of copper forms a green coating (basic copper carbonate); silver forms a black coating (Ag2S).
